lead: A `lateinit` property read inside the class that declares it is `E0428` unless a write came first on the same path, so the textbook injection shape does not compile.
body: `rule:classes/lateinit-read-before-write` runs the flow analysis per method, so a method that only reads `$this->printer` is refused however the caller set the object up, while the same read from outside the class is left to throw at run time. Put the read in the method that does the write, or outside the class.
